steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each service needs a transition step, each data item a transfer method, and the date must follow the agreed notice.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Data item with no transfer method
findings.fix: Name the transfer method and its test

findings.title: Transition date before the agreed notice
findings.fix: Move the date after the notice

outcome.notChecked: Data quality in the source system.

pros: Checks a service with no transition step, a data item with no transfer method, and a transition date before the agreed notice.

input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-hro-transition-plan skill on the records for this review.
